component.name: GamesTask
component.script:
sub init() m.functionName = "run" end sub
function IsGame(n as String) as Boolean keys = [" x ", " vs ", " vs. ", " v ", "ao vivo", "libertadores", "champions", "brasileir", "campeonato", "copa ", "rodada", "ufc", "nba", "nfl", "final"] for each k in keys if Instr(1, n, k) > 0 then return true end for return false end function
sub Publish(found as Object, checked as Integer, total as Integer) found.SortBy("ts") out = [] for each g in found ln = ClockStr(g.ts) + " " + g.title + " " + g.chan if g.alts > 0 then ln = ln + " (+" + g.alts.ToStr() + " canais)" out.Push({ id: g.id, line: ln }) end for m.top.games = out m.top.status = "Verificando canais... " + checked.ToStr() + "/" + total.ToStr() end sub
sub run() dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") nowSec = dt.AsSeconds() dt.ToLocalTime() since = dt.GetHours() * 3600 + dt.GetMinutes() * 60 + dt.GetSeconds() dayStart = nowSec - since dayEnd = dayStart + 86400
m.top.status = "Procurando canais de esportes..." cats = HttpGet(Api("get_live_categories")) if type(cats) <> "roArray" m.top.status = "Não foi possível carregar os canais." m.top.done = true return end if
words = ["esporte", "sport", "futebol", "premiere", "dazn", "espn", "jogos", "combate", "libertadores", "copa", "champions", "nba", "nfl", "ufc", "tnt", "paulista", "brasileir", "campeona", "ppv"] chans = [] nc = 0 for each c in cats if nc < 12 and chans.Count() < 160 nm = Norm(Sx(c.category_name)) hit = false for each w in words if Instr(1, nm, w) > 0 then hit = true end for if hit nc = nc + 1 lst = HttpGet(Api("get_live_streams", "&category_id=" + Sx(c.category_id))) if type(lst) = "roArray" for each ch in lst if chans.Count() < 160 then chans.Push({ id: Sx(ch.stream_id), name: Sx(ch.name) }) end for end if end if end if end for
total = chans.Count() if total = 0 m.top.status = "Nenhum canal de esportes encontrado." m.top.done = true return end if
port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") xfers = {} seen = {} found = [] idx = 0 active = 0 checked = 0 while idx < total or active > 0 while active < 6 and idx < total ch = chans[idx] idx = idx + 1 x = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") x.SetPort(port) x.SetUrl(Api("get_short_epg", "&stream_id=" + ch.id + "&limit=6")) x.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") x.InitClientCertificates() if x.AsyncGetToString() xfers[x.GetIdentity().ToStr()] = { x: x, ch: ch } active = active + 1 end if end while msg = wait(15000, port) if type(msg) <> "roUrlEvent" then exit while if msg.GetInt() = 1 id = msg.GetSourceIdentity().ToStr() rec = xfers[id] xfers.Delete(id) active = active - 1 checked = checked + 1 if rec <> invalid and msg.GetResponseCode() = 200 d = ParseJson(msg.GetString()) if type(d) = "roAssociativeArray" ls = d.epg_listings if type(ls) = "roArray" for each e in ls if type(e) = "roAssociativeArray" ts = Int(Val(Sx(e.start_timestamp))) te = Int(Val(Sx(e.stop_timestamp))) if ts < dayEnd and te > nowSec - 7200 t = B64(Sx(e.title)) nt = Norm(t) if IsGame(nt) dk = nt + ts.ToStr() if seen.DoesExist(dk) seen[dk].alts = seen[dk].alts + 1 else g = { id: rec.ch.id, ts: ts, title: t, chan: rec.ch.name, alts: 0 } seen[dk] = g found.Push(g) end if end if end if end if end for end if end if end if if checked mod 5 = 0 then Publish(found, checked, total) end if end while Publish(found, checked, total) m.top.status = "" m.top.done = true end sub
